status_note: A summary written for ELI Legal, in its own words. It is not the text of the instrument and has not been validated by a qualified lawyer. Check the official text before relying on any statement in it.
title: International arbitration: due process under the UNCITRAL Model Law and the New York Convention
instrument: UNCITRAL Model Law on International Commercial Arbitration (1985, amended 2006), Arts. 18, 24(3), 31, 34(2)(a)(ii); Convention on the Recognition and Enforcement of Foreign Arbitral Awards (1958), Art. V(1)(b)
issuer: United Nations Commission on International Trade Law
description: The core of due process in arbitration. Many seats have adopted the Model Law, among them Ireland (Arbitration Act 2010) and Germany (Tenth Book of the ZPO).

requirements.title: Equal treatment and a full opportunity to present one's case
requirements.text: The parties are treated with equality and each is given a full opportunity of presenting its case.
requirements.instruction: Set out the material and arguments of each party with equal care; never omit a party's position because it is shorter or less clearly put.

requirements.title: What the tribunal may rely on is shared
requirements.text: Everything one party supplies is communicated to the other, and any document on which the tribunal may rely is communicated to the parties.
requirements.statement: Any document or authority in this report on which the tribunal may rely, including any found by research, has been or will be communicated to the parties.

requirements.title: The award and its reasons are the tribunal's
requirements.text: The award is made, reasoned and signed by the arbitrators.
requirements.instruction: Do not draft an award, a decision or reasons for one, in whole or in part.

requirements.reference: Model Law Art. 34(2)(a)(ii); New York Convention Art. V(1)(b)
requirements.title: The risk to the award
requirements.text: An award can be set aside, or refused recognition, where a party was unable to present its case. Material not put to the parties is the usual way that happens.
